title: KMP Mutiara Sentosa 2 ferry fire
summary: An Indonesian passenger ferry caught fire while sailing from Surabaya to Makassar on August 2, 2026, resulting in deaths, injuries, and missing persons with ongoing rescue operations.

events.chapter_summary: The Indonesian ferry KMP Mutiara Sentosa 2 caught fire on August 2, 2026, while traveling from Surabaya to Makassar, resulting in at least five deaths and 41 missing persons, with 225 rescued and ongoing rescue operations.

The ferry KMP Mutiara Sentosa 2 caught fire near Madura island approximately 35 km north of Sapudi island around 06:00-07:00 local time on August 2, 2026, with the Surabaya Search and Rescue office notified at 08:24 local time.
